{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure consistency
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute the unadjusted response rate difference (F - M)
response_rates = trial.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
unadjusted_diff = response_rates['F'] - response_rates['M']

# Compute response rates by sex and arm
response_by_sex_arm = trial.groupby(['sex', 'arm'])['responded'].mean().unstack(level='arm')

# Compute within-arm differences (treatment - control)
within_arm_diff = response_by_sex_arm['treatment'] - response_by_sex_arm['control']

# Compute arm counts
arm_counts = trial['arm'].value_counts()

# Compute weighted average of within-arm differences, weighted by arm size
# This gives the adjusted difference in response rate between females and males
weighted_diff = (within_arm_diff['F'] * arm_counts['treatment'] + 
                 within_arm_diff['M'] * arm_counts['control']) / (arm_counts['treatment'] + arm_counts['control'])

# Print all key values for grounding
print("Unadjusted response rate difference (F - M):", unadjusted_diff)
print("Response rates by sex and arm:")
print(response_by_sex_arm)
print("Within-arm differences (treatment - control):")
print(within_arm_diff)
print("Arm counts:")
print(arm_counts)
print("Weighted average difference (F - M):", weighted_diff)"}
